name: Staff alert (email)
description: enhanced-event-handler.ts:460-475. Variables: message, urgency. The recipient is STAFF, not a patient — this is the case that requires messages.recipient_id to be nullable.
subject: [{{context.urgency}}] Staff alert

name: Staff alert (Slack)
description: enhanced-event-handler.ts:445-456. The source builds this inline as `[${urgency}] ${message}` and posts to the HARDCODED channel 'staff-alerts' (:448). The channel is now tenant_packs.config.slackChannels.staffAlerts.

name: Shift reminder (email)
subject: Your shift on {{context.shiftDate}}
content:
Your shift is on {{context.shiftDate}} at {{context.shiftTime}}{{#if context.location}}, {{context.location}}{{/if}}.

— {{tenant.name}}

name: Shift reminder (SMS)
description: enhanced-event-handler.ts:506-522. Identical variables to the email — the one case where the source does not narrow for SMS.

name: Emergency alert (email)
description: enhanced-event-handler.ts:546-560. The source hardcodes to: 'emergency-team@medspa.com' at :549 — now tenant_packs.config.emergencyContacts. Priority is forced to URGENT regardless of event.priority.
subject: EMERGENCY: {{context.message}}

name: Emergency alert (Slack)
description: enhanced-event-handler.ts:533-543. Posted UNCONDITIONALLY — outside any event.channels check — to the hardcoded 'emergency-alerts'. An emergency a caller could silence by omitting a channel would be a bad design, so this entry does not participate in the channel intersection.

name: System alert (Slack)
description: enhanced-event-handler.ts:708-718. Built inline as `[${severity}] ${systemComponent}: ${message}`, posted to the hardcoded 'system-alerts'. Priority is URGENT when severity is CRITICAL, else the event's own (:716).

name: General notification (email)
description: enhanced-event-handler.ts:653-667. Variables: subject, message. Addressed to recipientEmail, not patientEmail.
subject: {{context.subject}}

name: Approval escalation (email)
description: P6's SLA sweeper notifies the fallback approver through the engine itself. Not from the source — this playbook is the engine self-hosting.
subject: An approval has been waiting for you
